semanticDecisions: the gate is a necessary condition only: a trigram the source lacks proves the needle absent; a needle whose probed trigrams are all present runs the exact search as before, so every positive stays exact

two probes, the middle trigram and then the first (the last, for a four-unit needle): an absent needle rarely shares both with the source, a needle joined from two present pieces fails at its middle, and a present needle pays two binary searches at most; needles under three units and sources under 2048 units take no gate, where the stock search over the whole source costs about what the probes do (three probes over a 1024-unit floor, measured first, cost present needles over 1024-unit sources up to 200 ns)

the source facts are the existing ones of the M3 needle's lane: a source searched once never pays them, a source searched again pays them once (A34), whichever needle kind searched it; no new cache and no new retained bytes, so the retained-bytes ceiling and invariant 12 stand
the facts cover the whole source and the gate answers for any range of it: absence from the whole proves absence from the range
